public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs are mathematically restricted to repeating existing actions and cannot do genuinely new things.

statement.excerpt: Being “first” — on the “frontier” one might say — is something that people crave when they can’t find something within, and it’s exactly the fuel that grifters crave, because LLMs are constantly humming with the sense that they’re about to do something new, even though they’re mathematically restricted to repeating other actions.

from_speaker: mathematically restricted to repeating other actions
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is an absolute technical restriction: LLMs cannot generate substantively new solutions beyond reproducing existing actions.
A verified new mathematical construction or algorithm is an ordinary test of substantive novelty; subjective artistic originality or consciousness is not required.
The claim concerns an enduring restriction on LLMs existing by publication, so the target period includes their history through the post date rather than only the latest quarter.
An LLM used with an evaluator is relevant to the broad impossibility claim. Whether the sentence intended only an unaided model is a material scope ambiguity.
criteria.support_condition: A mathematical result establishes the asserted repetition-only restriction for the claimed class of LLMs under ordinary operating conditions, and the supposed novel outputs are shown to be repetitions within that restriction.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented LLM-based procedure generates verified new constructions or solutions beyond previously known results, contradicting the asserted general prohibition on substantive novelty.
